get_involved_description: Our free resources make it easier to spread Bitcoin adoption. Stickers, flyers, business kits, and an open-source codebase anyone can contribute to.
get_involved_intro_1: It can be depressing to live in the current state of our world.
get_involved_intro_2: Our money is broken. As a result, fundamental pieces of society are broken too.
get_involved_intro_3: If you're already into Bitcoin, you know the feeling of hope that Bitcoin can bring. Hope for a brighter future made possible by better money.
get_involved_intro_4: But so many people around you don't know about Bitcoin. They're living in the same broken world as you, but without a beacon of hope to help them through the darkness.
get_involved_intro_5: You can help change that. We've made several free resources to make it easier to spread the hope that Bitcoin brings to those around you.
get_involved_sticker_image_alt: Free Bitcoin text sticker pack from bitcoin.rocks
get_involved_sticker_content_1: You can help educate those around you about Bitcoin without having to interact with anyone. Simply put one of our free Bitcoin stickers in public.
get_involved_sticker_content_2: Hundreds of people scan the QR codes on these stickers each month. The inflation stickers link to a page about
get_involved_sticker_content_3: Bitcoin as a solution to inflation.
get_involved_sticker_content_4: The other stickers link to our educational home page that shows people how
get_involved_sticker_content_5: Bitcoin is building a better world.
get_involved_sticker_content_6: By putting these stickers up in your community in places people will see them, you can help those around you take their first steps down the Bitcoin rabbit hole.
get_involved_card_stickers_title: Request a free Bitcoin sticker pack mailed to your door
get_involved_flyers_image_alt: Preview of the free printable Bitcoin flyer from bitcoin.rocks
get_involved_flyers_content_1: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
get_involved_flyers_content_2: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
get_involved_flyers_content_3: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.
get_involved_card_flyers_title: Download and print a free Bitcoin flyer
get_involved_business_content_1: Want to help build the Bitcoin circular economy? Our Bitcoin Business Kit makes it easy to approach a business about accepting Bitcoin payments.
get_involved_business_content_2: Each business kit includes flyers that highlight the pros of accepting Bitcoin payments. Each flyer links to a variety of
get_involved_card_business_title: Request a free Bitcoin Business Kit
get_involved_github_content_1: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.
get_involved_github_content_2: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
get_involved_github_content_3: Fork the repository, open a pull request, file an issue, or just star the project to show your support. Every contribution helps Bitcoin reach more people.
